findings.title: Mock try-on is the documented default
findings.recommendation: Verify actual runtime provider and test real inference.

findings.title: Local authentication is the documented default
findings.recommendation: Verify authentication mode in the running environment.

findings.title: Catalog is unpopulated and feed has no product candidates
findings.root_cause: scripts/catalog/seed_local.py halted because 'own-wardrobe' source was unregistered
findings.recommendation: Register and clear 'own-wardrobe' source and run seed_local.py --apply

findings.title: Closet collection is completely empty in local database
findings.root_cause: No wardrobe save events occurred due to empty catalog items in feed
findings.recommendation: Populate catalog and verify end-to-end save-to-closet flow

findings.title: VTO async dispatch stalls in non-Celery development environments
findings.evidence: backend/fashx/tryon/ports_dispatch.py logs warning and defers dispatch silently
findings.root_cause: CeleryTryOnJobDispatcher has no in-process or async background worker fallback
findings.recommendation: Add in-process / async fallback dispatcher for local dev environments

findings.title: Settings screen exposes internal database UUIDs to consumers
findings.evidence: mobile/app/settings/index.tsx displays raw userId and photo.id
findings.root_cause: Diagnostic identifiers were rendered in consumer settings card without styling abstraction
findings.recommendation: Redesign settings into consumer account profile and privacy controls
